title: A small-molecule inhibitor of TopBP1 exerts anti-MYC activity and synergy with PARP inhibitors.
authors: Lin, Fang-Tsyr; Liu, Kang; Garan, Lidija A Wilhelms; Folly-Kossi, Helena; Song, Yongcheng; Lin, Shwu-Jiuan; Lin, Weei-Chin
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接筛选小分子抑制剂靶向TopBP1的BRCT7/8结构域，研究其抗肿瘤活性，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作抑制，但核心是蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: We have previously identified TopBP1 (topoisomerase IIbeta-binding protein 1) as a promising target for cancer therapy, given its role in the convergence of Rb, PI(3)K/Akt, and p53 pathways. Based on this, we conducted a large-scale molecular docking screening to identify a small-molecule inhibitor that specifically targets the BRCT7/8 domains of TopBP1, which we have named 5D4. Our studies show that 5D4 inhibits TopBP1 interactions with E2F1, mutant p53, and Cancerous Inhibitor of Protein Phosphatase 2A. This leads to the activation of E2F1-mediated apoptosis and the inhibition of mutant p53 gain of function. In addition, 5D4 disrupts the interaction of TopBP1 with MIZ1, which in turn allows MIZ1 to bind to its target gene promoters and repress MYC activity. Moreover, 5D4 inhibits the association of the TopBP1-PLK1 complex and prevents the formation of Rad51 foci. When combined with inhibitors of PARP1/2 or PARP14, 5D4 synergizes to effectively block cancer cell proliferation. Our animal studies have demonstrated the antitumor activity of 5D4 in breast and ovarian cancer xenograft models. Moreover, the effectiveness of 5D4 is further enhanced when combined with a PARP1/2 inhibitor talazoparib. Taken together, our findings strongly support the potential use of TopBP1-BRCT7/8 inhibitors as a targeted cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 我们此前已将TopBP1（拓扑异构酶IIβ结合蛋白1）确定为癌症治疗的一个有前景的靶点，鉴于其在Rb、PI(3)K/Akt和p53通路汇聚中的作用。基于此，我们进行了大规模分子对接筛选，以识别一种特异性靶向TopBP1的BRCT7/8结构域的小分子抑制剂，并将其命名为5D4。我们的研究表明，5D4抑制TopBP1与E2F1、突变型p53以及癌性蛋白磷酸酶2A抑制剂之间的相互作用。这导致E2F1介导的凋亡激活以及突变型p53功能获得的抑制。此外，5D4破坏TopBP1与MIZ1的相互作用，进而使MIZ1能够结合其靶基因启动子并抑制MYC活性。而且，5D4抑制TopBP1-PLK1复合物的结合，并阻止Rad51病灶的形成。当与PARP1/2或PARP14抑制剂联合使用时，5D4协同作用有效阻断癌细胞增殖。我们的动物研究已证明5D4在乳腺癌和卵巢癌异种移植模型中的抗肿瘤活性。此外，5D4与PARP1/2抑制剂talazoparib联合使用时，其效果进一步增强。综上所述，我们的发现强烈支持将TopBP1-BRCT7/8抑制剂作为靶向癌症治疗的潜在应用。
